standard.summary: CPU 侧锁页缓冲，默认关闭。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Pinned CPU-side buffers; off by default.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 把全部 block 权重（Klein 9B 约 16.6GB）固定在内存里做异步 H2D。Windows 16G 卡实测开启后约 40 秒/步，关闭约 6 秒/步（WDDM 共享显存压力），所以默认关闭；内存充足且非 Windows 时可短测后再开。

advanced_en.principle: Pins every block weight (about 16.6GB for Klein 9B) in host RAM for async H2D. On a Windows 16G card it measured about 40s/step pinned versus about 6s/step unpinned (WDDM shared-memory pressure), so it is off by default; with plenty of RAM on non-Windows hosts, run a short test before enabling it.
